overview_description.description: Mirendil is an artificial intelligence research company that develops systems designed to automate and improve the process of AI research and development. The company trains models specialized in AI R&D and designs research workflows intended to make experimentation faster, more capable, and increasingly autonomous. Its technology aims to reduce the expertise and infrastructure barriers associated with frontier AI development, enabling researchers in fields such as biology, chemistry, robotics, and drug discovery to use advanced AI capabilities without building their own large-scale AI laboratories. Mirendil focuses on creating self-improving research systems that can support scientific and technological discovery across multiple domains.
